h1: Shopify app integrations for the tools merchants already use
overview: We connect your app to the tools your merchants rely on, such as Klaviyo, Google Analytics, a shipping service, an accounting tool or your own backend. Each connection uses proper OAuth or safe key storage, retries when a service is down and shows clear messages in the admin if something fails. We test with sandbox accounts and document each flow.

faq: Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Google Analytics, ShipStation, QuickBooks, Slack and any tool with a public API are common. Send the API documentation of yours and we confirm the fit first.
Do the connected tools cost extra?
Possibly. Each tool bills you or your merchants directly. Our price covers building and testing the connection only, and we point out any paid API tiers before we start.
Can you connect to my own backend?
Yes. We build against your API, or write a small service if you do not have one. We agree the data fields and the direction of the sync in writing before building.
Keys are stored encrypted on your server and never sit in the front-end code. We never ask for passwords. Add us as a team member or send test keys through a secure channel.
